state.you_speak_for: the health regulator (DHA, the Dubai Health Authority) that licenses the laboratory

evidence.text: The laboratory shall keep record of the communication with the patient.
Critical laboratory results shall be reported clearly to the patient.
The laboratory should direct the patient to seek further medical advice.
The laboratory shall have a policy for identifying and reporting critical results.

result.text: The laboratory shall keep record of the communication with the patient.

criteria.COMMUNICATED: A person acknowledged the current revision; the communication record can be written.
criteria.AWAITING_ACK: The result was sent or delivered but no one has acknowledged the current revision.
criteria.DIRECT_NOT_PERMITTED: The shown clauses route this result to a physician, not directly to the patient.
criteria.NOT_YET_SENT: Nothing has been communicated yet and nothing prevents a first send.
criteria.INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: The case facts and clauses shown do not settle it.

obligation.instructions: Under the DHA clauses in `evidence`, where does the duty to communicate this result stand now? An acknowledgment counts only for `case.current_result_revision`; a delivery receipt is not an acknowledgment.
